title: BayesTS: Bayesian time series estimation in C++
description:
A C++ library for Bayesian time series estimation by Markov chain Monte Carlo, driven either from the command line or from an embedded host such as an R package. Its scope is the class of methods rather than a fixed list of models.

This version registers twenty algorithms across four model families: vector autoregressions with constant or time-varying coefficients and a Wishart, independent gamma or stochastic volatility error precision; two quantile VARs under an asymmetric Laplace likelihood; the same six specifications as vector error correction models, beside a compact-regressor implementation of the constant-coefficient VEC; four dynamic factor models; and a factor augmented VAR.

The numerical core performs no input or output, prints nothing and holds no global state beyond the random number generator, so the same sampler objects serve a command-line program and a host that must keep control of its own random number stream and console. One HDF5 model file holds the data, priors, starting values and results of one model, so a run is fully described by the file it is given.
